text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae hasn't shown up for 
training. After waiting a while—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! Thank you for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I only meant to do a short livestream, 
but I ended up getting so many 
comments..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I am so, so very sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Hokko Tarumae deeply reflected on 
her actions, I decided to let the matter 
rest.
